# BNP Paribas India Branch

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **partial** · Budget spent (9 searches, 6 documents). Could not locate any MCA CSR-2 annexure, BRSR filing or annual report page disclosing actual India CSR spend figures, average net profit, prescribed CSR, project-level amounts, named implementing NGOs (beyond one historical hospital pledge), quantified outcome metrics, an RFP, or a published shared CSR mailbox. Only CSR policy documents and the corporate CSR web page were reachable.

BNP Paribas operates in India through several distinct Section 135-bound legal entities that jointly fund a common non-profit implementing arm, BNP Paribas India Foundation (est. 2019). Each entity — BNP Paribas India Branch, BNP Paribas India Solutions Private Limited (ISPL, a BNP Paribas SA subsidiary), and BNP Paribas Securities India Private Limited (SIPL) — has published its own CSR policy stating it is bound by Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013 and implements CSR either through the India Foundation or another registered implementing partner. No public source gave actual FY2022-23–FY2024-25 CSR spend, budget, project-level allocations, sector/state/district splits, or named current NGO partners; the one specific named partner activity found (COVID-19 support to two hospitals) predates the requested years and was reported without a fiscal year label.

Website: https://www.bnpparibas.bank.in

## What it set out to find

- identity/identifiers for BNP Paribas India entities (branch, ISPL, SIPL, India Foundation)
- confirm whether Section 135 applies to the India branch/subsidiaries (foreign banking entity)
- funder_csr_years for FY2024-25, FY2023-24, FY2022-23 (prescribed CSR, spend, unspent, impact assessment)
- funder_csr_spend by project/aggregate: sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount
- footprints (demonstrated spend geography) vs stated_geography (priority areas)
- named NGO/implementing-agency partners by fiscal year
- programs/themes run by BNP Paribas India Foundation
- metrics/outcomes
- published CSR contact mailbox
- documents (CSR policy, annexures, annual reports)
- open RFPs
